# Download autogenerated subtitles

## Summary

Include YouTube auto-generated subtitles in Kapsel downloads so videos without manual captions can still expose local caption tracks.

## Requirements

- Request auto-generated subtitles during yt-dlp video downloads.
- Preserve the existing local subtitle ingestion and caption serving behavior.
- Keep subtitle language and format handling bounded to the existing defaults.

## Acceptance Criteria

- yt-dlp download invocations include the option to write auto-generated subtitles.
- Existing subtitle download behavior remains covered by tests.
- Relevant Go tests pass.

## Notes

- Prefer the smallest option change in the downloader path.
